[id 12]
Annual revenue: 7 * 1.5 = 10.5
Annual cost: 3
Annual profit: 10.5 - 3 = 7.5
Cost to recover: 90
Years: 90 / 7.5 = 12
After 12 years, he has broken even. He "starts earning" (net positive) after year 12. However, in these math problems, usually, the calculation for the break-even point is requested. 90/7.5 = 12.

[id 13]
Let x be the starting amount.
Green: x/3. Remaining: 2x/3.
Red: 2x/3 - 2. Remaining: 2x/3 - 2.
Orange: 1/2 * (2x/3 - 2) = x/3 - 1.
Remaining: (2x/3 - 2) - (x/3 - 1) = x/3 - 1.
We know x/3 - 1 = 5.
x/3 = 6 => x = 18.
